question:
In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom/Phrase.

To lay someone by the heels
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option(1) i.e. To confine somebody in prison**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"To lay someone by the heels"** means to imprison or confine someone. (किसी को जेल में डाल देना)

 
 
• **Example:** The notorious criminal was finally laid by the heels after a long pursuit.
 
 
 
• **"To confine somebody in prison"** refers to putting someone in jail or under restraint. (किसी को जेल में बंद करना)
 
 
• **Example:** The thief was laid by the heels after being caught red-handed.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the meaning of the idiom **'To lay someone by the heels'** is best expressed by **Option(1)**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option(1) i.e. To confine somebody in prison**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **To gain support **(समर्थन प्राप्त करना): To receive backing or help from others.

 
 
• **Example:** He worked hard to gain support for his new project from the community.
 
 
 
• **To praise someone **(किसी की प्रशंसा करना): To express admiration or approval.
 
 
• **Example:** The teacher praised the student for his excellent performance in the exam.
 
 
 
• **To force someone for something** (किसी को कुछ करने के लिए मजबूर करना): To make someone do something against their will.
 
 
• **Example:** He was forced by his parents to pursue a career in medicine.
 
 

41:T4f1,The correct answer is** 'Option 2'.**
